title: FTDI DMG detach failure leaves an unprocessed archive target
summary: The macOS FTDI Make recipe installs the final archive before detach and stripping. Xcode can veto normal unmount; make then fails while the unprocessed target remains and may be reused. Repair the transaction, cover failures and rerun the real library build.
evidence: Previous diagnostic: make -C indigo_libs all exited 2 at Makefile:220; target matched the vendor archive and retained all nine embedded libusb objects. Baseline e5f25534910b7f51d3e1e87daace13dcd9820d90:indigo_libs/Makefile:213-228.

resolution.evidence: 002-fix-ftdi-build/verification.md: seven focused regression cases, successful real universal library build, all nine embedded libusb objects absent per FTDI slice, no leftover mount
